title: Accounts Assistant
company: Four Squared Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Accounts Assistant
Location: Worcestershire
Contract Type: Temporary
Salary: Competitive
Start Date: ASAP
The Opportunity We are currently recruiting for an Accounts Assistant to join a busy finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous experience working within an accountancy practice who is looking to start immediately.

You will possess a solid understanding of core accounting principles, alongside exposure to basic tax compliance and self-assessment processes.

Key Responsibilities
- Bank reconciliations and maintaining accurate financial records
- Assisting with the preparation of VAT returns
- Supporting month-end processes and management accounts preparation
- Liaising with clients and responding to finance-related queries
- Assisting with bookkeeping duties across a portfolio of clients
- Supporting the preparation and submission of self-assessment tax returns
- Assisting with basic personal tax computations
- Maintaining client records and ensuring compliance deadlines are met
- General finance administration and ad hoc support to the wider team

Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience working within an accountancy practice is essential
- Experience of bookkeeping and management of day-to-day accounting records
- Exposure to self-assessment tax returns and basic tax compliance duties
- Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero, Sage, QuickBooks or similar
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- AAT qualified or currently studying (desirable but not essential)
- Able to work independently and manage multiple priorities

What's on Offer
- Immediate start available
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunity to develop tax and accounting knowledge further
- Exposure to a varied client portfolio

If you are an experienced Accounts Assistant with accountancy practice experience and a working knowledge of tax and self-assessment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for immediate consideration.

title: Wedding & Events Co-ordinator
description:
Wedding & Events Co-ordinator

Worcestershire

Permanent

£28,000 - £35,000 + Bonus

An exceptional opportunity has arisen for an ambitious, organised and customer-focused Wedding & Events Coordinator to join a highly respected and established events and hospitality business based in Worcestershire.

This is far more than a traditional events role. It offers the chance to be involved in the planning, coordination and delivery of a diverse range of memorable experiences, from luxury weddings and private celebrations to corporate events and bespoke catering functions.

Working within a passionate and supportive team, you will play a pivotal role in bringing clients' visions to life, guiding them through every stage of their journey from initial enquiry and venue viewing through to seamless event execution. You'll be responsible for creating unforgettable experiences, building lasting relationships with clients and suppliers, and ensuring every event is delivered to the highest possible standard.

No two days are the same. One day you could be conducting venue tours with prospective couples, the next coordinating suppliers, overseeing event set-ups, creating engaging social media content, or managing the smooth delivery of a stunning wedding or large-scale private function. This is a hands-on role that combines event planning, client relationship management, operational coordination, hospitality and marketing, making it an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and rewarding environment.

The business operates across a seven-day events schedule, meaning flexibility is essential. In return, you'll join a successful and growing organisation known for delivering exceptional customer experiences, offering genuine career development opportunities, a collaborative team culture and the chance to be part of some truly special occasions.

Working Hours
- 5-day rota working pattern
- Typically 9-10 days off per month
- Frequent weekend working required
- Event days generally start between 9am and 10am and finish in the early evening
- Occasional evening and late-night event cover may be required
- Additional support may be required during peak wedding season

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £28,000 - £35,000 depending on experience
- Paid overtime
- Performance-related bonuses
- Company pension scheme
- Free on-site parking
- Company laptop provided
- Meals provided during shifts where applicable
- Company social events
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Genuine long-term career opportunity within a growing business

Key Responsibilities
- Manage wedding and event enquiries from initial contact through to final planning meetings
- Conduct venue show-rounds and convert enquiries into bookings
- Liaise with suppliers including florists, DJs, entertainers and venue partners
- Coordinate all event logistics and client requirements
- Oversee event setup, including room layouts, décor and equipment
- Manage and support operational staff during events
- Ensure venue presentation and cleanliness standards are maintained
- Create engaging marketing content for social media and online platforms
- Support catering operations, including order processing and event logistics
- Assist with promotional activities and business development initiatives

About You

The ideal candidate will possess:
- Previous experience within weddings, events, hospitality or venue management
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent communication and customer service abilities
- Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive and adaptable attitude
- Confidence working independently and as part of a team
- Knowledge of social media platforms, including Instagram and TikTok
- Ability to remain calm under pressure during busy event periods

Requirements
- Experience within hospitality, events or a customer-facing environment
- Full driving licence and access to a vehicle due to the rural location
- Flexibility to work weekends as part of a rota
- Availability during peak wedding and events seasons

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about creating memorable experiences and developing a long-term career within the events and hospitality industry.

Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.

Thank you for taking the time to apply.

For more information on this position, please contact James Randall at Four Squared Recruitment.

title: Administration Assistant
company: Herefordshire and Worcestershire Health and Care NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Herefordshire and Worcestershire Health and Care NHS Trust
description: Full time role available in the MSK physiotherapy admin team. We are looking for a highly motivated, methodical, and organised individual to join our team of physiotherapy admin staff. The job is varied and busy, working across two sites in Worcester and Droitwich. Flexibility and negotiation to choose a main base will be given to the successful candidate. Full training will be given to the successful applicant for all in house processes and IT packages. You will work as part of a team in each base and share additional admin duties between you. This role is face to face providing some front of house duties and so it is not suitable for working from home. The applicant will be expected to have great people skills, be a confident communicator and have sound basic IT skills. We pride ourselves in providing outstanding care to patients across Herefordshire and Worcestershire and will offer you full support to achieve this. Full training is provided. If you would like to discuss informally if this is the right role for you, get in touch with Recruiting Manager. Applicants must read the attached guidance notes before submitting your application for full understanding of Trust requirements. The role involves data input and booking appointments on our patient clinical notes system, customer service through taking phone calls, handling patient queries, ordering equipment as well as organising clinics and other general admin duties. The post holder will Behave consistently with the values and beliefs of the organisation and promotes these on day to day basis. Act as a role model to colleagues, always seeking to maintain the highest standards of professionalism. Use their initiative and take responsibility for themselves and the quality of their work and the service provides they provide to patients Provide effective and efficient administrative support to the department. Undertake administration duties that are specific to the role. Provide administrative support as required, e.g. typing, data inputting, filing, scanning/copying and telefaxing, in line with Trust Policies and Procedures. Answer/deal with both face-to-face and telephone enquiries. Deal with incoming and outgoing post. Undertake reception duties, if and when required, to cover for staff absences. For full details of the duties and criteria for the role please refer to the job description and person specification attached.

description: The Podiatry Service at The John Anthony Centre is seeking a skilled, well-motivated Administrative Assistant to join our friendly and dedicated administrative team. This is a 30 hour post, though part-time hours will be considered for the right candidate, with a minimum of 25 hours. You will work closely with--and be fully supported by--our experienced administrator within a well-established service based at Kidderminster Health Centre. We are looking for an individual who is self-driven, reliable, and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Strong communication skills and a positive, proactive approach are essential. You will receive full Trust and Service Induction, along with ongoing guidance and supervision from our existing team to help you settle into the role and develop confidently. We are committed to supporting flexible working and are happy to discuss working patterns that meet individual needs while ensuring the smooth running of the service Applicants must read the attached guidance notes before submitting your application for full understanding of Trust requirements. A role in our team offers a welcoming, supportive environment where your contribution truly matters. Each day brings variety and purpose: you'll handle and organise incoming and outgoing mail, respond to emails promptly, speak with patients, carers and colleagues over the phone, process referrals, book appointments for the clinical team, arrange home visits, maintain supplies, and carry out a range of general administrative tasks that keep the service running smoothly. You'll be based in a friendly office setting, working closely with our podiatrists to ensure their clinical day flows effortlessly. From coordinating referrals and appointments to providing practical support throughout the day, you'll play a key part in helping them deliver excellent patient care. Although you'll work independently, you'll always have guidance from the senior administrator and strong connections with the wider admin team across community podiatry. It's a place where people look out for one another, share knowledge, and collaborate to make the service the best it can be. Undertake administrative duties specific to the role eg typing standard keyboard skills required, data inputting, filing, scanning, referral processing, adding appointments to clinicians diaries and home visits. Add new patient spells and referral on the system in a timely manner. Answer and deal with telephone enquiries in a professional manner seeking guidance as required, recording details accurately and forwarding to the relevant member of the team in a timely manner Process incoming and outgoing mail Order and maintain stock supplies Prepare for and attend appraisal meetings and participate in any relevant training programmes required by the Trust For full details of the duties and criteria for the role please refer to the job description and person specification attached.
